description: This source file defines the class SugarFieldRelate, which extends SugarFieldBase. It contains methods for rendering detail, edit, popup, and search views for relate fields within the SuiteCRM application, as well as import sanitization logic specific to relate fields. The class manages the behavior and presentation logic associated with relate fields linking different modules, including field formatting, view-building, and import handling.

classes.name: SugarFieldRelate
classes.description: Class with methods to handle rendering and sanitization of relate fields in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty output for the detail view of the relate field, managing link display.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty output for the edit view, arranging callback functions and field mappings.

methods.name: getPopupViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares smarty for the popup view for relate field selection.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Creates Smarty output for search view, configuring search parameters and data.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Formats contact name fields based on user locale preferences.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input values during import, performing lookups and relating records accordingly.
